items.source: NOTE: This callback won't be triggered for singleton beans lazily initialized on demand after BeanFactory bootstrap, and not for any other bean scope either. Carefully use it for beans with the intended bootstrap semantics only.
items.translation: 注意：此回调不会为在 BeanFactory 引导后按需懒式初始化的单例 Bean 触发，也不会为任何其他 Bean 作用域触发。请仅针对具有预期引导语义的 Bean 谨慎使用它。

items.source: Sometimes we need to be able to avoid this happening, for example, if it will lead to a circular reference or if the existing target instance needs to be preserved. This implementation returns false unless the bean name indicates an "original instance" according to AutowireCapableBeanFactory conventions.
items.translation: 有时我们需要避免这种情况发生，例如，如果会导致循环引用或需要保留现有的目标实例。此实现除非根据 `AutowireCapableBeanFactory` 约定，bean 名称指示为“原始实例”，否则返回 `false`。

items.source: Important: Advisors are sorted in precedence order, from the highest precedence to the lowest. "On the way in" to a join point, the highest precedence advisor should run first. "On the way out" of a join point, the highest precedence advisor should run last.
items.translation: 重要提示： Advisor 按优先级顺序排序，从高到低。在到达连接点（join point）时，优先级最高的 Advisor 应首先运行；在离开连接点时，优先级最高的 Advisor 应最后运行。
